title: Kon Tum in a day
summary: Dry phở, the timber church and the museum on Nguyen Hue, then the prison. Kon Klor and Kon K’Tu sit across the river.

stops.name: Dry pho
stops.note: The two bowls around the market, from about 6:00 to 10:00.

stops.name: Wooden church
stops.note: The timber cathedral on Nguyen Hue, between services if you want a quiet nave.

approach.note: Walk from the centre along Nguyen Hue.

stops.name: Kon Tum Provincial Museum
stops.note: The provincial museum at 659 Nguyen Hue.

stops.name: Kon Tum Prison
stops.note: The French-era cells on Truong Quang Trong.

approach.note: Walk or ride to Truong Quang Trong.

additions.name: Kon Klor Communal House
additions.note: The Ba Na communal house beside the Đăk Bla, about 3 km or about 4 km from the centre.

additions.name: Kon K'Tu Village
additions.note: The Ba Na village on the far bank, across the Kon Klor bridge.

seoDescription: One day in Kon Tum: dry phở, the wooden church, the museum, and the prison. Kon Klor and Kon K’Tu are the river additions.
